title: A ratio is a fraction
text: 18 to 24 means $$\frac{18}{24}$$. Simplifying a ratio uses the same idea as simplifying a fraction: divide both parts by their greatest common factor. A common mistake is to subtract 6 from both parts and get 12 to 18, which is not the same ratio. What is the greatest common factor of 18 and 24?

title: Divide both parts
text: $$18 \div 6 = 3$$ and $$24 \div 6 = 4$$. The simplified ratio is $$\frac{3}{4}$$. What is the numerator of that simplified ratio?

title: Worked solution
text: $$18:24 = \frac{18}{24} = \frac{3}{4}$$. Common mistake: reversing the order, or subtracting instead of dividing. General rule: write the ratio as a fraction in the order the words give you, then divide the numerator and the denominator by their greatest common factor.
